dn8:17.14: imāya ca kassapa mattāya iminā ca tapopakkamena samaṇo vā abhavissa brāhmaṇo vā dujjāno sudujjāno netaṃ abhavissa kallaṃ vacanāya
dn8:17.16: sakkā ca paneso abhavissa ñātuṃ gahapatinā vā gahapatiputtena vā antamaso kumbhadāsiyāpi
dn8:17.17: ayaṃ sākabhakkho vā hoti sāmākabhakkho …pe… vanamūlaphalāhāro yāpeti pavattaphalabhojīti.
dn8:17.18: yasmā ca kho kassapa aññatreva imāya ca mattāya aññatra iminā ca tapopakkamena samaṇo vā hoti brāhmaṇo vā dujjāno sudujjāno tasmā etaṃ kallaṃ vacanāya
dn8:17.20: yato ca kho kassapa bhikkhu averaṃ abyāpajjhaṃ mettacittaṃ bhāveti āsavānañca khayā anāsavañcetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
dn8:17.21: ayaṃ vuccati kassapa bhikkhu samaṇo itipi brāhmaṇo itipi.
dn8:17.22: sāṇāni cepi kassapa dhāreti masāṇānipi dhāreti …pe… sāyaṃtatiyakaṃpi udakorohanānuyogamanuyutto viharati.
dn8:17.23: imāya ca kassapa mattāya iminā ca tapopakkamena samaṇo vā abhavissa brāhmaṇo vā dujjāno sudujjāno netaṃ abhavissa kallaṃ vacanāya
dn8:17.25: sakkā ca paneso abhavissa ñātuṃ gahapatinā vā gahapatiputtena vā antamaso kumbhadāsiyāpi
dn8:17.26: ayaṃ sāṇānipi dhāreti masāṇānipi dhāreti …pe… sāyaṃtatiyakaṃpi udakorohanānuyogamanuyutto viharatīti.
dn8:17.27: yasmā ca kho kassapa aññatreva imāya ca mattāya aññatra iminā ca tapopakkamena samaṇo vā hoti brāhmaṇo vā dujjāno sudujjāno tasmā etaṃ kallaṃ vacanāya
dn8:17.29: yato ca kho kassapa bhikkhu averaṃ abyāpajjhaṃ mettacittaṃ bhāveti āsavānañca khayā anāsavañcetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
dn8:17.30: ayaṃ vuccati kassapa bhikkhu samaṇo itipi brāhmaṇo itipīti.
dn8:18.1: evaṃ vutte acelo kassapo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
dn8:18.2: katamā pana sā bho gotama sīlasampadā katamā cittasampadā katamā paññāsampadāti.
dn8:18.3: idha kassapa tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho …pe…
dn8:18.6: idha kassapa bhikkhu pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharati
dn8:19.8: so iminā ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ anavajjasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti
dn8:20.7: imāya ca kassapa sīlasampadāya cittasampadāya paññāsampadāya aññā sīlasampadā cittasampadā paññāsampadā uttaritarā vā paṇītatarā vā natthi.
dn8:21.3: yāvatā kassapa ariyaṃ paramaṃ sīlaṃ nāhaṃ tattha attano samasamaṃ samanupassāmi kuto bhiyyo
dn8:21.4: athakho ahameva tattha bhiyyo yadidaṃ adhisīlaṃ.
dn8:21.7: yāvatā kassapa ariyā paramā tapojigucchā nāhaṃ tattha attano samasamaṃ samanupassāmi kuto bhiyyo
dn8:21.8: athakho ahameva tattha bhiyyo yadidaṃ adhijegucchaṃ.
dn8:21.11: yāvatā kassapa ariyā paramā paññā nāhaṃ tattha attano samasamaṃ samanupassāmi kuto bhiyyo
dn8:21.12: athakho ahameva tattha bhiyyo yadidaṃ adhipaññā.
dn8:21.15: yāvatā kassapa ariyā paramā vimutti nāhaṃ tattha attano samasamaṃ samanupassāmi kuto bhiyyo
dn8:21.16: athakho ahameva tattha bhiyyo yadidaṃ adhivimutti.
dn8:22.1: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ kassapa vijjati yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ
dn8:22.2: sīhanādaṃ kho samaṇo gotamo nadati tañca kho suññāgāre nadati no ca parisāsūti.
dn8:22.4: sīhanādañca samaṇo gotamo nadati parisāsu ca nadati no ca suññāgāre nadatīti evamassu kassapa vacanīyā.
dn8:22.5: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ kassapa vijjati yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ
dn8:22.6: sīhanādaṃ samaṇo gotamo nadati parisāsu ca nadati no ca kho visārado nadatīti.
dn8:22.8: sīhanādañca samaṇo gotamo nadati parisāsu ca nadati visārado ca nadatīti evamassu kassapa vacanīyā.
dn8:22.9: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ kassapa vijjati yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ
dn8:22.10: sīhanādañca samaṇo gotamo nadati parisāsu ca nadati visārado ca nadati no ca kho naṃ pañhaṃ pucchanti
dn8:22.11: pañhañca naṃ pucchanti no ca kho nesaṃ pañhaṃ puṭṭho byākaroti
dn8:22.12: pañhañca nesaṃ puṭṭho byākaroti no ca kho pañhassa byākaraṇena cittaṃ ārādheti
dn8:22.13: pañhassa ca byākaraṇena cittaṃ ārādheti no ca kho sotabbaṃ maññanti
dn8:22.14: sotabbañcassa maññanti no ca kho sutvā pasīdanti
dn8:22.15: sutvā cassa pasīdanti no ca kho pasannā pasannākāraṃ karonti pasannā ca
dn8:22.16: pasannākāraṃ karonti no ca kho tathattāya paṭipajjanti
dn8:22.17: tathattāya ca paṭipajjanti no ca kho paṭipannā ārādhentīti.
dn8:22.19: sīhanādañca samaṇo gotamo nadati parisāsu ca nadati visārado ca nadati pañhañca naṃ pucchanti pañhañca nesaṃ puṭṭho byākaroti pañhassa ca veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ ārādheti sotabbañcassa maññanti sutvā cassa pasīdanti pasannā ca pasannākāraṃ karonti tathattāya paṭipajjanti paṭipannā ca ārādhentīti evamassu kassapa vacanīyā.
dn8:23.1: ekamidāhaṃ kassapa samayaṃ rājagahe viharāmi gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
dn8:23.2: tatra maṃ aññataro te sabrahmacārī nigrodho nāma paribbājako adhijegucche pañhaṃ pucchi
dn8:23.4: byākate ca pana me attamano ahosi paraṃ viya mattāyāti.
dn8:23.5: ko hi bhante bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā na attamano assa paraṃ viya mattāya
dn8:23.6: ahaṃpi bhante bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā attamano paraṃ viya mattāya
dn8:23.8: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti evameva bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo desito
dn8:23.9: esāhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
dn8:23.10: labheyyāhaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
dn8:24.1: yo kho kassapa aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhati pabbajjaṃ ākaṅkhati upasampadaṃ so cattāro māse parivasati catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya
dn8:24.3: sace bhante aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhati pabbajjaṃ ākaṅkhati upasampadaṃ cattāro māse parivasati catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya ahaṃ cattāri vassāni parivasissāmi catunnaṃ vassānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāyāti.
dn8:24.4: alattha kho acelo kassapo bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ alattha upasampadaṃ.
dn8:24.5: acirūpasampanno kho panāyasmā kassapo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto nacirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati
dn8:24.6: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
dn8:24.7: aññataro kho panāyasmā kassapo arahataṃ ahosīti.
